title: Best Hair Straighteners UK
short: Hair straighteners compared by plate width, heat control and price, from budget buys to cordless and steam options.
intro: A straightener's plate width and heat consistency matter more than raw brand name for how well it performs on your specific hair type. This guide compares straighteners tested by Marie Claire UK, spanning budget picks, cordless options and steam-based tools for damaged hair.

guide.q: How wide should the plates be?
guide.a: Narrower plates suit shorter or finer hair and give more precision for smaller sections. Wider plates cover more hair per pass, which suits thicker or longer hair and can cut down overall styling time.

Ceramic plates heat evenly and are gentle on hair. Titanium heats up faster and reaches higher temperatures, suiting thick or coarse hair. Tourmaline-coated plates are designed to reduce frizz and add shine as you style.

guide.q: Is a steam straightener worth it for damaged hair?
guide.a: Steam-based tools like the L'Oreal Steampod add moisture while styling rather than relying purely on dry heat, which can be gentler on hair that's already damaged or prone to dryness.

guide.q: Is a cordless straightener practical for everyday use?
guide.a: Cordless straighteners are useful for travel or styling away from a socket, but battery life limits how long you can use them continuously. For daily use at home, a corded model gives unlimited styling time.
